name: wds_vtab-smallnorb_label_azimuth
description: A vision transfer benchmark built from the SmallNORB dataset that asks models to predict object azimuth (viewpoint) labels from images. It measures a model's ability to infer object orientation and generalize to viewpoint classification under controlled imaging conditions.
reputation: Part of VTAB/CLIP-style evaluation suites; modestly used as a standard transfer task for assessing viewpoint/pose classification.
